body:
Real CI failure on commit 02c9aa4 (Bazel Test job, ~50s to fail). Reproduced the exact commit locally 3 ways (warm cache, bazel clean --expunge, fully cold output_base/repository_cache/empty-HOME) -- all pass 18/18 tests cleanly, no code bug found. Could not retrieve real job log text (403 unauthenticated Actions API, no gh CLI/token in this sandbox). Hardened the bazel test step with a 3-attempt retry loop against the most likely honest explanation -- a transient bzlmod/rules_cc fetch hiccup against the Bazel Central Registry, refetched fresh every run with no repo-cache step. Commit ac1204e. CHANGELOG.md write blocked again by the known treeiii-owned ACL (mask r--), documented honestly rather than worked around. If retries don't resolve it, next step is wiring a real GitHub token into this job to pull actual log text.

⚓ ☃
title: Investigate + harden PAPERCRAFT CI Bazel Test failure (run 33647252365)
